description: This file is a PHP class defining the controller for marketplace promotions in the OpenCart admin system. It manages fetching, caching, and displaying promotion data within the admin interface.

classes.name: Promotion
classes.description: Controller class for managing marketplace promotions in the OpenCart admin panel. It loads promotion data, interacts with cache and models, and renders the promotion view.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that processes the request, retrieves or fetches promotion data, and renders the marketplace promotion view.
